causal_diagnostic_authority.head: dfea35a171956895c2c67d287f3c1f49b3905264
causal_diagnostic_authority.use: Motivates a formula-derived total-balance resolution policy. D3 residual magnitudes and residual/tolerance ratios are forbidden inputs to the P2E21 formula.

methodological_authority.method: representation/cancellation-floor analysis from spacing of internal/base water content, with explicit warning that the estimated floor is not itself a universal tolerance

purpose: Test whether a pre-solve, state- and material-derived upper bound on the total-column water-content representation floor removes the remaining total-balance-only Reference retries while preserving Reference endpoints and the original P2E18 temporal-stability requirements.

control_policy.role: paired endpoint-neutrality control, not a new independent holdout

forbidden_inputs: current or prior failed residual magnitude
post-solve internal theta when choosing the current tolerance
representation_bounded_policy.mathematical_basis: For positive normal water contents restricted to theta < theta_s, spacing(theta_s) is used as a prospective upper bound on the unknown internal-theta spacing term appearing in the P2E07/D3 representation-floor model.
representation_bounded_policy.runtime_check: Whenever internal provider_theta is available, verify spacing(provider_theta_i) <= spacing(theta_s_material) for every node; violation blocks policy qualification and does not trigger retuning.

policy_endpoint_neutrality.population: Every case/level where both control and representation-bounded policies are route-valid.
policy_endpoint_neutrality.budgets: exact frozen P2E18 Se-stratified REF-HIGH stability budgets
policy_endpoint_neutrality.interpretation: A representation-bounded policy that changes overlapping accepted endpoints beyond the already frozen numerical-reference budget is not admitted merely because it improves route validity.

ref_high_qualification.case_qualified_if: All three routes are valid; both fine endpoint comparisons pass every frozen metric; representation-bound runtime check passes.

outcome_policy.if_policy_restores_routes: Report exact route restoration and casewise REF-HIGH qualification. Do not describe restored cases as independent holdout evidence.
outcome_policy.if_policy_does_not_restore_routes: Retain unresolved cases. Do not enlarge the representation bound or add an empirical factor.
outcome_policy.if_policy_neutrality_fails: Policy is not qualified for REF-HIGH even if route validity improves.

nonclaims: P2E21 does not alter production Reference tolerances.
P2E21 does not establish RossFast speedup or equal-error performance.
P2E21 is not an independent confirmation of P2E20 because the same Reference cases are reused.
The representation bound is a research numerical-policy construct for REF-HIGH, not an observational or physical error bound.
